owner: Compliance Engineering; MLRO accountable for consequential decisions
purpose: Disposition of twelve items shown in the user-provided framework infographic, mapped to this repository without new production runtime dependencies.

status_semantics.reference-control: Adopt security reference for controls/evaluations, not a runtime package or certification.
status_semantics.deferred: Do not add package or deploy service absent an approved case, data/privacy review and performance/security evidence.

frameworks.name: LangGraph
frameworks.rationale: Use only if an explicitly approved multi-step model agent is required; current workflows are deterministic and approval-gated.
frameworks.adoption_gate: model-action security design, role-bound approvals, data flow and failure-mode tests

frameworks.name: CrewAI
frameworks.rationale: Multiple independent AI personas add autonomous delegation, not screening coverage.
frameworks.adoption_gate: human-owned decision authority, least privilege, red-team and threat assessment

frameworks.name: Microsoft Agent Framework
frameworks.rationale: No need for a second production agent orchestrator or overlapping workflow engine.
frameworks.adoption_gate: new approved use case with signed action authorization and rollback/runbook

frameworks.name: Haystack
frameworks.rationale: Legal citations already have deterministic source verification; no customer RAG index is in scope.
frameworks.adoption_gate: source provenance, retrieval accuracy, PII classification and poisoning evaluation

frameworks.name: FAISS
frameworks.rationale: Semantic index is not needed for the current exact-evidence screening pipeline.
frameworks.adoption_gate: measured retrieval benefit, index integrity, access controls and accuracy gate

frameworks.name: vLLM
frameworks.rationale: No self-hosted LLM inference service is part of the authorized operating model.
frameworks.adoption_gate: GPU/hosting controls, license, residency, evaluations and cost/availability plan

frameworks.name: Ollama
frameworks.rationale: A local model runner does not independently prove sanctions/media coverage or model accuracy.
frameworks.adoption_gate: approved model inventory, privacy impact, evals, resource bounds and operations owner

frameworks.name: Chroma
frameworks.rationale: Another retrieval store would introduce embedding access and poisoning risks without a current use case.
frameworks.adoption_gate: index tenant isolation, PII minimization, retention and deletion test

frameworks.name: Pinecone / Qdrant / Weaviate
frameworks.rationale: Choose at most one only after a documented need for a governed semantic corpus.
frameworks.adoption_gate: data residency/vendor DPA, security review, per-record RBAC and deletion evidence

frameworks.name: MITRE ATLAS
frameworks.rationale: Use to structure model abuse, data poisoning and prompt-injection attack hypotheses; reference, not a runtime dependency.
frameworks.adoption_gate: maintained AI threat scenarios and tested control evidence

frameworks.name: OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications
frameworks.rationale: Prioritize prompt injection, sensitive-data disclosure, poisoning, excessive agency and unbounded consumption.
frameworks.adoption_gate: red-team regression and documented residual-risk owners

frameworks.name: MITRE ATT&CK
frameworks.rationale: Use for credential access, exfiltration and CI/supply-chain attack paths; not an AI hosting framework.
frameworks.adoption_gate: threat-informed investigation scenarios, log/audit evidence and controls

threat_scenarios.remaining: Other languages, multimodal and adaptive attack variants require scheduled red teaming.
Vendor processing terms, residency and DPA still require separately authorized legal evidence.
A production model-action adapter is not authorized; never infer signed MLRO approval from a boolean.
Live provider quota and actual invoicing cannot be certified by unit tests.
Independent news provider availability is degraded; source integrity does not prove subject coverage.
A green secret scanner is not proof every security alert inventory is empty.
Latest 2026-10-13 live screening had 1 of 991 subjects without a verified adverse-media backbone; new live complete evidence and human review required.

operational_status: NOT_CERTIFIED; fail-closed screening coverage still must be proven live
